q1.explanationZh: achieve 及物动词“实现；达到”，achieve success“取得成功”。

q2.explanationZh: achieve 加 -ment 构成名词 achievement“成就”。

q3.explanationZh: acid 形容词“酸的”，名词“酸”，acid rain“酸雨”。

q5.explanationZh: acquire“获得；学到”，acquire knowledge“获取知识”。

q6.explanationZh: across“横穿（表面）”，through 表示从内部穿过。

q7.explanationZh: act 作动词“行动；扮演”，作名词“行为；法令；（戏）幕”。

q8.explanationZh: act 的名词 action“行动”，take action“采取行动”。

q9.explanationZh: active“积极的”，take an active part in“积极参与”。

q11.explanationZh: act 加 -or 表示人，actor“男演员”。

q12.explanationZh: actor 的女性形式是 actress“女演员”。

q14.explanationZh: actual 加 -ly 构成副词 actually“实际上”。

q15.explanationZh: adapt“（使）适应；改编”，注意不要与 adopt“采纳；收养”混淆。

q16.explanationZh: adapt 的名词 adaptation“改编本”。

q17.explanationZh: add“加；补充说”，add A to B“把 A 加入 B”。

q18.explanationZh: addict 作动词“使沉迷”，作名词“入迷的人”，be addicted to“沉迷于”。

q19.explanationZh: add 的名词 addition，in addition to“除……之外（还）”。

q20.explanationZh: addition 加 -al 构成形容词 additional“额外的”。

q21.explanationZh: address 名词“地址；演说”，动词“对……讲话；处理”。

q22.explanationZh: adequate“足够的；符合要求的”，反义词 inadequate。

q25.explanationZh: admire“钦佩”，admire sb. for sth.“因……钦佩某人”。

q26.explanationZh: admit 的名词 admission“准许进入；入场费”。

q27.explanationZh: admit“准许进入；承认”，过去式 admitted（双写 t）。

q28.explanationZh: adolescent 名词“青少年”，形容词“青春期的”。

q29.explanationZh: adopt“采纳；收养”，注意不要与 adapt“适应”混淆。

q30.explanationZh: adore 去 e 加 -able 构成 adorable“可爱的”。

q31.explanationZh: adore“敬爱；非常喜爱”，形容词 adorable。

q32.explanationZh: adult 名词“成年人”，形容词“成年的”。

q34.explanationZh: advanced 形容词“先进的；高级的”。

q36.explanationZh: take action“采取行动”，action 前不加冠词。

q38.explanationZh: adapt oneself to“使自己适应……”，to 是介词。

q40.explanationZh: add A to B“把 A 加入 B”。

q41.explanationZh: add up to“合计达”，不用于被动语态。

q42.explanationZh: in addition to = besides = as well as“除……之外（还）”。

q43.explanationZh: adjust to“（使）适应”，to 是介词。

q44.explanationZh: admire sb. for sth.“因某事钦佩某人”，介词用 for。

q45.explanationZh: admit sb. to/into...“准许某人进入……”，be admitted to a university“被大学录取”。

accept: admit sth.; admit doing sth.; admit that

q46.explanationZh: admit“承认”后可接名词、动名词或 that 从句：admit sth. / admit doing sth. / admit that...。

q47.explanationZh: in sb.’s adult life“在某人的成年生活阶段”，adult 作定语。

q50.explanationZh: “他承认自己的过失”，acknowledge“承认”，陈述过去的事用过去式 acknowledged。

q51.explanationZh: a great 后接可数名词单数，achievement“成就”。

q52.explanationZh: act as“充当，起……作用”，情态动词 should 后用原形 act。

q53.explanationZh: 修饰名词 charge 用形容词 additional“额外的”；冠词 An 说明是元音开头。

q54.explanationZh: adequate food“足够的食物”，形容词修饰名词。

q55.explanationZh: under one’s administration“在某人的管理下”，所有格后用名词。

q56.explanationZh: 与 children 并列，用复数名词 adolescents“青少年”。

q57.explanationZh: be admitted into“被准许进入”，被动语态用过去分词 admitted（双写 t）。

q58.explanationZh: “被父母收养”，might have been done 用过去分词 adopted。

q59.explanationZh: “the more + 形容词……, the more……”，系动词 is 的表语用形容词 advanced“先进的”。

q60.sampleAnswer: To her delight, she has been admitted to Fudan University.
references: To her delight, she has been admitted to Fudan University.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “令某人开心的是”= to one’s delight；“被……录取”= be admitted to。

q61.sampleAnswer: She acquired a knowledge of English by careful study.
references: She acquired a knowledge of English by careful study.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “精通英语”可译为 acquire a knowledge of English；“通过认真学习”= by careful study。

q62.sampleAnswer: I admire him for his courage in face of difficulty.
references: I admire him for his courage in face of difficulty.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: 用 admire sb. for sth.“因某事钦佩某人”；“面对困难”= in (the) face of difficulty。

q63.sampleAnswer: Students should be encouraged to take an active part in classroom activities.
references: Students should be encouraged to take an active part in classroom activities.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “应当被鼓励”= should be encouraged to do；“积极参加”= take an active part in；activities 用复数。

q64.sampleAnswer: To be healthy one must have an adequate diet.
references: To be healthy one must have an adequate diet.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “想要健康”用不定式 To be healthy 表目的；“足够的饮食”= an adequate diet。

q65.sampleAnswer: Although he is a newcomer, he is quick to adapt himself to new circumstances.
references: Although he is a newcomer, he is quick to adapt himself to new circumstances.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: although 与 but 不能同时使用；“适应”= adapt (oneself) to，to 是介词。

q66.sampleAnswer: So addicted to online shopping are many people that they visit shopping websites every day.
references: So addicted to online shopping are many people that they visit shopping websites every day.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “沉溺于”= be addicted to；so...that 中 so + 形容词置于句首时，句子要倒装。

q67.sampleAnswer: With the start of the new semester, students need to quickly adjust their mindset to more intense and demanding academic tasks.
references: With the start of the new semester, students need to quickly adjust their mindset to more intense and demanding academic tasks.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “随着……”= with...；“调整……以适应……”= adjust sth. to sth.。

q68.sampleAnswer: In addition to the application in the medical field, X-rays are employed to identify oil paintings and coins.
references: In addition to the application in the medical field, X-rays are employed to identify oil paintings and coins.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “除了……之外（还）”= in addition to；“被用来做某事”= be employed/used to do sth.。

q69.sampleAnswer: It is proved that the more you try, the more likely you are to achieve success in advance.
references: It is proved that the more you try, the more likely you are to achieve success in advance.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “事实证明”= It is proved that...；“越……越……”= the more..., the more...；“取得成功”= achieve success；“提前”= in advance。
